test_title: All India SSC MTS & Havaldar 2025: Marks Booster Mega Live Test - 04
subject: general
question: Pipe A can fill a tank in 699 minutes and Pipe B can fill the same tank in 1398 minutes. If both pipes are opened together, how many minutes will it take to fill the empty tank?
solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by Pipe A to fill the tank = 699 minutes

Time taken by Pipe B to fill the tank = 1398 minutes

**Formula Used:**

Total Work = LCM of time taken by each pipe

Efficiency = Total Work / Time taken

Total Time = Total Work / Total Efficiency

**Calculation:**

LCM
